outputs.explanation: Panel A shows micrographs/reconstructions (2D projections, density maps, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows micrographs/reconstructions (2D projections, density maps, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots (per-cell data) overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots (per-cluster data) overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of percentage of molecules in clusters showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots (per-cell data) overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution reconstructions and trajectory overlays (micrograph-type images), not an averaged data plot.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution, not a mean plot) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph/other visualizations of single-molecule tracks), not a plot of averaged data.
